::: {.card .fade-in .delay-1}
## Adaptive MPC Controller Based on Reinforcement Learning (PPO)

::: {.project-card__meta}
[Project Lead]{.tag} [2025.12 – 2026.03]{.tag}
:::

::: {.project-card__media}
![](images/VFH.gif){fig-alt="VFH obstacle avoidance demonstration" loading="lazy"}
:::

**Project Description:** Combined reinforcement learning with model predictive
control to enhance UAV flight robustness in complex environments, especially
under disturbed positioning information.

**Key Contributions:**

1. **Algorithm Integration**: Integrated an Actor-Critic RL algorithm with the MPC controller, using RL to adaptively adjust the MPC cost function so the system adapts to environmental change.
2. **Model Training**: Trained with PPO, constructing Actor-Critic models on an MLP network.
3. **Differentiable MPC**: Adopted a differentiable MPC framework, folding the MPC optimization into the RL training pipeline.
4. **C++ / Python Integration**: Implemented the differentiable MPC controller in C++ and integrated it into RL training (Python), improving training and inference efficiency.

::: {.skill-badges}
[Python]{.tag} [C++]{.tag} [PyTorch]{.tag} [Differentiable MPC]{.tag} [PPO]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.card .fade-in .delay-2}
## Decentralized Multi-Robot Ergodic Planning for Exploration of Unknown Dynamic Environments

::: {.project-card__meta}
[First Author · RAL (in submission)]{.tag .tag--accent} [2025.09 – 2026.02]{.tag}
:::

::: {.project-card__media}
![](images/iDMED.gif){fig-alt="Decentralized multi-robot ergodic planning simulation" loading="lazy"}
:::

**Project Description:** A unified framework for distributed collaborative search
that handles two challenges at once — unknown dynamic environments and
decentralized robots. It integrates:

- Bayesian filter
- Communication-forwarding mechanism
- Belief built from ground truth and Bayesian estimation
- Time-decaying ergodic metric
- Probabilistic connectivity
- iLQR solver

::: {.skill-badges}
[Ergodic Control]{.tag} [iLQR]{.tag} [Bayesian Filter]{.tag} [Multi-Robot]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.card .fade-in .delay-3}
## Wind-Disturbed UAV Target Search & Delivery

::: {.project-card__meta}
[Project Lead]{.tag} [2024.05 – 2024.10]{.tag}
:::

::: {.project-card__media}
![](images/Fuzzy_PID.gif){fig-alt="Fuzzy PID control demonstration" loading="lazy"}
:::

**Project Description:** Outdoor environment. A UAV carrying a 1.5L bottle flew
autonomously over an 8m × 80m runway to:

1. Take off autonomously from the designated point.
2. Search an 8 × 5m area 30m out and deliver to one of three white barrels (Ø 30, 20, 15 cm) — smaller barrels scored higher.
3. Reconnoiter hazards in an 8 × 5m area 65m out and transmit data to the console.
4. Return autonomously and land.

A unified UAV platform was required (dual fisheye cameras + 2D LiDAR).

**Key Contributions:**

1. **Fuzzy PID Controller (C++)**: Fuzzy rules adaptively tune PID coefficients for precise control under wind disturbance.
2. **VFH Path Planning**: Solved feasible points via VFH and smoothed paths with B-spline optimization.
3. **Filtering**: Combined Kalman and low-pass filters to denoise and smooth the controller output.

::: {.skill-badges}
[C++]{.tag} [Fuzzy PID]{.tag} [VFH]{.tag} [Kalman Filter]{.tag}
:::
:::

::: {.card .fade-in .delay-4}
## Obstacle Forest Express Delivery UAV

::: {.project-card__meta}
[Project Lead]{.tag} [2023.10 – 2024.05]{.tag}
:::

::: {.project-card__media}
![](images/EGO-Planner.gif){fig-alt="EGO-Planner obstacle avoidance demonstration" loading="lazy"}
:::

**Project Description:** Indoor environment. A UAV carrying 3 × 100g boxes
operated in a 10 × 10m area:

1. Take off autonomously from the takeoff point.
2. Search a 10 × 8.5m area for 5 targets and deliver — scored by accuracy and target weight — while avoiding dense obstacles.
3. Enter a 10 × 1.5m corridor, traverse it (two 80cm-wide narrow passages), and land precisely.

**Key Contributions:**

1. **ROS Flight Code (C++)**: Obstacle avoidance and delivery in obstacle-forest and narrow-corridor environments.
2. **Localization & Path Generation**: FAST-LIO and Ego-Planner for localization and feasible routes, with an MPC controller tracking paths for obstacle avoidance.
3. **MPC Controller (C++)**: Computes UAV acceleration inputs online from targets and constraints to track the global path.

::: {.skill-badges}
[ROS]{.tag} [FAST-LIO]{.tag} [Ego-Planner]{.tag} [MPC]{.tag} [C++]{.tag}
:::
:::
